newsitem.title: USA: Riviera shareholder group grants option.
newsitem.headline: Riviera shareholder group grants option.

text.p: Riviera Holdings Corp said on Friday some of its institutional investors granted a one-year option to Allen Paulson, thoroughbred owner and chief executive of Full House Resorts Inc, to buy their shares for $15 each.

Morgans Waterfall Group, a holder of 25.9 percent of its shares granted one option, while other options granted to Paulson came from mutual fund group Stein Roe, a holder of a 17.4 percent stake, and Sun Life, holder of 15.5 percent of the company, chief financial officer Duane Krohn said.

Based upon talks with Paulson, Riviera's management understands that Paulson is reviewing the offer, but the offer will depend upon, among other things, his discussions with Riviera's board, the company said.
Riviera's management believes that if Mr. Paulson chooses to become involved with casino and hotel, it will be on a cooperative basis and in its best interests, Riviera said.
Paulson is best known in horse racing circles as the former owner of Cigar, which won 16 consecutive victories before being put out to stud. Cigar's winning streak tied that held by Citation.
